messages.author: b47f1d365cd5e499
messages.subject: FIELDimageR installation issues
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to install FIELDimageR package in R 4.3.0. I followed both methods: 
 

install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR")

If the method above doesn't work, use the next lines by downloading the FIELDimageR-master.zip file

setwd("~/FIELDimageR-master.zip") # ~ is the path from where you saved the file.zip unzip("FIELDimageR-master.zip") file.rename("FIELDimageR-master", "FIELDimageR") shell("R CMD build FIELDimageR") # or system("R CMD build FIELDimageR") install.packages("FIELDimageR_0.3.2.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type="source") 
But in both cases I found the attached error message. I need help to solve this issue.

Correct, I asked Filipe to review the change before applying it.

You can work with it now if you want to try. If you go to the GitHub repo and change the branch from main to fix-missing-elide-fx (direct link: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR/tree/fix-missing-elide-fx), then click on the green Code button and select Download Zip, you can then follow Filipe's instructions for installing from source code: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR/tree/fix-missing-elide-fx#installation

The only difference will be that the zip file is called FIELDimageR-fix-missing-elide-fx.zip

Best,
